title: Entire Germantown Condo Nashville Local Experience
description: Get the best of both worlds - Live like a local while still in close proximity to Nashville’s major tourist attractions. This rustic condo in the heart of Germantown is walking distance to everything - Downtown, Printer’s Alley, the “Honkey-Tonk” Highway. Or stay in and listen to our vinyl record collection, watch some AAA baseball down the street, and sip on some complimentary Jack Daniels, and maybe venture out for a walk around Bicentennial Park or enjoy the Farmers Market on weekends.
